outcome: Prevalence of early initiation of breastfeeding
Prevalence of breastfeeding on the previous day
finding: While breastfeeding was the norm, the prevalence of early initiation of breastfeeding and exclusive breastfeeding was low and associated with factors at individual, family, health facility and environmental levels.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was associated with lower prevalence of early initiation of breastfeeding.
